aub_upgrade_chain_xiuyan_mines_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = xiuyan_mines_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_xiuyan_mines_02_trigger = yes

		}
		remove_building = xiuyan_mines_01
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = xiuyan_mines_02

			limit = { has_building = xiuyan_mines_02 }
